lines.en: Bandages drag on the floor.
These two legs of mine are terribly heavy.
A step, a halt; my joints are stiff.
Wrapped for centuries; I cannot hurry.
I came walking out of the tomb.
There is nothing under the wrappings.
I walk toward your warmth.
My foot crushed a brick.
Red Ribbon's orders still hold.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，所以不喘
lines.en: I need no air, so I never pant.
Every step sheds dust.
I am taller than the door.
I stand like a statue.
No expression beneath the bandages.
Dust gathers on my shoulders.
I do not breathe; I only wait.
This body should have stayed buried.
My fingers never unclench.
I count the cracks in the wall.
The air smells of the tomb.
I tilt my head; bones creak.
There has been no warmth in me for ages.

lines.zh: 几百年的时间我都站得住
lines.en: I can stand for centuries.
A strip of wrapping came loose.
I stay still, and even insects avoid me.
I await the next order.
You carry the heat of the living.
I watch you through the gap in my wrappings.
I can hear your heartbeat.
I face you without moving.
My eyes are long gone.
You are the first who did not run.

lines.zh: 我们也算同类，都是不死
lines.en: We are alike, you and I: undying.
You are inside my shadow.
This close, you should step back.
Red Ribbon told me to watch you.

lines.zh: 我抬手，只是为了看清你
lines.en: I raise a hand only to see you better.
You wear very little cloth.
I am counting your ribs.
The fear in your eyes is real.
I am no ghost; I am a soldier.
My face is made of bandages.
You stand firm; rare.
My bandages were cut.
More grave soil fell off me.
That did not bring me down.

lines.zh: 布条下露出干枯的东西
lines.en: Something withered shows beneath the cloth.
I do not cry out; I could not if I tried.
I swayed, then kept walking.
Your hand will ache.
Dust fell from my shoulder.
Such wounds are centuries old.
I slowed, but did not stop.
There is no food in the tomb.
I do not eat; I obey.
You hold something up; I do not understand.
That smell reminds me of the living.
I have no use for this at all.
Keep it for yourself.
I will not stop for food.
Orders are louder than hunger.
I reach out, then withdraw.
Such things are useless to the dead.
You bumped into grave cloth.
I neither yield nor step aside.
One shove and you were knocked back.
Sand fell off me.
That was a hard collision.
Are you hurt?
I am too heavy to shift.

lines.zh: 绷带缠到你的护甲上了
lines.en: My bandages caught on your armor.
I stand as steady as a tomb post.
Go around me next time.
The dead do not speak of such things.
Dust is my companion.
Centuries have taken that from me.

lines.zh: 我连自己的名字都记不清
lines.en: I barely recall my own name.
My bandages are loose; no time for this.
I need only an order.
There is no heart under these wraps.
That is not the right thing to ask.
I have belonged to this tomb all along.
We should not stand together.
Bending down takes me a long time.
This fell from your hand.
I pick it up; I see no use in it.
My hands are wrapped too thickly.
I hold it, unsure whom to give it to.
It looks tiny in my palm.
I hand it back with stiff motions.
The things of the living are too light.
I set it on the ground.
Come over and take it yourself.
The order came: you.
I have already selected you.
Your warmth is easy to spot.
I will catch you without running.
Red Ribbon wants you.
I begin walking toward you.
You will not get far on those legs.

lines.zh: 沙里的脚印，通到你脚下。
lines.en: The prints in the sand lead to your feet.
I have locked onto the living.
You are already on my path.
This corridor has no turns.
I am blocking the door.

lines.zh: 你听见沙子落下的声音吗
lines.en: Do you hear the sand falling?
Let us begin right now.
I will not stop for anything.
You have been assigned to me.
I follow, one step at a time.
Running faster will not help.
I am behind you; I can hear.
My steps are heavy.
You turned a corner; I am still here.
I am in no hurry, and never lost.
You are panting; I am not.
I am driving you toward the corner.
My bandages scrape the floor.
Look back and I close in.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离在缩短
lines.en: The distance between us keeps shrinking.
You hid in the cupboard.
I wait before the cupboard.
I have had no eyes to close for centuries.
I will wait until you come out.
Your scent is unmistakable.
This door will not stop me.
My arm comes down.
A bandaged fist.
This blow comes down heavy.
I am poor at holding back.
You rock backward from the hit.
Strips of cloth whip your face.
No anger in me, only orders.
Your armor took most of it.
My finger bones are hard as stone.
You retreat; I keep walking.
This strike carries no feeling.
I stop once I land it.
Slow, but accurate.
Something shattered under your feet.
One more step and you hit the wall.
The next blow will be faster.
I rise out of the sand.
The tomb door was pushed open from within.
Dust arrives first; I follow.
This body was sealed a long while.
I woke up right here.
Grave soil still clings to my wrappings.

lines.zh: 你听见石头挪动的声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear the stone shift?
I stand much taller than you.
Red Ribbon let me out.
This place will become a tomb.
The air has turned dry.
I made no cry when I appeared.
Sand fell before I did.
I shook the earth from my wrappings.
The order was just given.
Have you seen what I look like?
I was lifted up from below.

lines.zh: 没有心跳的东西也能站起来
lines.en: Even a heartless thing can stand.
Dry cloth catches fast.
The fall rattled my bones.
Water soaked through my wrappings.
The blast sent strips flying.
The arrow sank into cloth.
The charm stiffened my body.

lines.zh: 死人不吃东西，只是更干
lines.en: The dead do not eat; we only dry out.
Lightning singed a layer of cloth.
This emptiness is deeper than a tomb.
